name: Under One Roof
source:
You finally found it: a room in a shared apartment in the big city, three months paid up front. But the moment you show up, luggage in hand and soaked from the rain, the truth hits. The "realtor" copied the real listing, swapped the phone number and vanished with your money.

The room belongs to Melissa and her older sister Sofia, the strict (and stunning) building manager who holds the lease. Broke and with nowhere to go, you get one chance: get a job, pay your way and follow her rules.

Your new job? Barista at the Grão & Sabor cafe, run by Ivy, a sharp-tongued goth manager who hates lazy employees and loves testing your limits.

[From [url=https://indiedeva.itch.io/under-one-roof]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你终于在大城市里找到了一间合租公寓的空房，还一口气预付了三个月房租。可就在你拎着行李、浑身湿透地冒雨赶到门口的那一刻，残酷的真相给了你当头一棒：那个所谓的“中介”盗用了真实房源信息、偷换了联系电话，卷走你的钱人间蒸发了。

这间屋子属于梅丽莎和她的姐姐索菲娅——那位手握租约、严厉冷峻（却又美得惊人）的公寓管理员。身无分文、无处可去的你只得到了唯一一次机会：找份工作、自食其力，并乖乖遵守她定下的规矩。

至于你的新工作？在“醇豆与风味”咖啡馆当咖啡师——店长艾薇是个毒舌的哥特风女人，最讨厌偷懒的员工，而且最爱试探你的底线。

[摘自[url=https://indiedeva.itch.io/under-one-roof]itch.io[/url]]
